//! The wiring of `greeting list`: the edge takes the clients its connections opened and the parts its
//! caller supplies, chooses each implementation, passes each client to each factory that needs it, and
//! builds the service it calls. It only constructs: opening a store is the connections' I/O. Nothing here
//! implements a port.

use super::connections::GreetingListConnections;

/// The dependencies the caller supplies.
pub(crate) struct GreetingListParts;

/// Wires the service from the clients and the supplied dependencies; it only constructs.
pub(crate) fn compose(connections: GreetingListConnections, parts: GreetingListParts) {
    let GreetingListConnections = connections;
    let GreetingListParts = parts;
}
